title: This is it. What you're looking for. These Views!
description:
Watch the Nashville skyline come to life in our beautiful modern home. You will be in the center of the action, music row, the Gulch/downtown Nashville, Vanderbilt, amazing restaurants, and more. Walk to the many restaurants, shops, and fun murals in the Gulch. A five minute drive to lower Broadway to visit the Honkytonks, Bridgestone Arena, music city Center, The Ryman auditorium, various museums, shopping, sporting events, and more. We are unique in that we own and manage this 1 property.

The space
In addition to the interior space you have a beautiful rooftop to enjoy with ample seating. The 2 car garage is such a plus.

Guest access
The entire space is all yours. No restrictions.

Other things to note
There are four flights of stairs to the rooftop. That is how we are able to offer these incredible views. There is no extra fee for the "stairmaster"  workout while you are here.  Ha ! And for those who are not interested in the bit of extra effort there is a queen bed on the lower floor - and 4 single beds on the main living floor. 2 king beds are on the level above the main living area.
